public.text: The practical test states that components failing the foundational-layer criteria “belong at the application layer.” However, the next subsection introduces a business-services layer that also contains DPI-H application components. The phrase “application layer” is therefore ambiguous.
public.suggestedRevision: Replace “application layer” with “functional or point-of-service application layer outside DPI-H,” or explicitly state whether the intended destination is the DPI-H business-services layer or the non-DPI-H operational layer.
